summary: This video showcases a fast 30-second clear of Ancient Battlefield Challenge 4 against the Level 300 Soul Devourer - Gruentius using a Dauntless team. The team composition consists of Nastjenka, Kurvida, Maashtur, Guinavivre, and Fathomdown. The creator notes that Maashtur can be swapped out for Vinyara if needed. Detailed gear builds and hero stats are displayed following the battle.
